formalization_scope: local deduction over audited black boxes
notes: Successor to LATT-0007, addressing LREV-0010. The open range is split into four disjoint guarded regimes so the critical-line case is reachable only through CriticalEndpointVanishes, making the (3,12), (5,8), (6,6), (7,4) one-marking derivations and the (4,10) direct route load-bearing instead of cited (LREV-0010-F02). Ionel and endpoint indices now carry geometry and coefficients (F03). Smooth-proper purity is pinned to the canonical index up to its purity tag, refusing perturbed weights (F04). The published-range control is typed by the pair and gated on the Table 1 bound (F05). Bergstrom-Faber-Payne Proposition 2.1 gets its own whole-group carrier and a distinct bridge to the lowest-weight piece (F06). Intermediate endpoint premises are gated on arithmetic rather than record membership, so the coherence premise is no longer redundant (F07). Target, prelude and required theorem type are unchanged from LG7D16-004.
